entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: your code, $20 off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. What brings you to Replogle Globes today?
Hi, Mia. I'm looking for a snowboard for my teenage son. He's just starting out, then we ski mostly in Quebec.
Sounds like a fun winter ahead for him in Quebec! I
I compared you with sports experts and decathlon. Price matters. But I want something that lasts more than one season.
That makes sense: a fair price, but
What held me back was the shipping time and not knowing which size to pick for his height.
Sizing for a growing teenager is tricky, and waiting
He's about five foot six. If the board comes with findings, would make it much easier for me.
